2608.25605.title: From Specialization to Generalization: Instruction-tuned LLMs for Robust Harmful Content Mitigation
2608.25605.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive performance across a wide range of general NLP tasks; however, their effectiveness in sensitive domains, such as hate speech detection, remains less clear. Prior studies comparing prompted LLMs with state-of-the-art encoder-based models (e.g., BERT variants (Roy et al., 2023; Dönmez et al., 2024)) have shown only marginal gains, suggesting that LLMs may not excel in hate speech detection or mitigation. In this work, we revisit this question through the lens of instruction tuning. By thoroughly unifying 36 English hate speech datasets spanning multiple labeling schemes, we fine-tune a generalist LLM, based on Qwen3 (Qwen Team, 2025), specifically for hate speech mitigation. Our results demonstrate not only state-of-the-art performance on in-domain benchmarks but also substantial improvements in cross-domain and cross-lingual generalization--areas where encoder-based specialist classifiers often struggle.
2608.25605.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在各種一般自然語言處理任務中展現出令人印象深刻的表現；然而，它們在敏感領域（如仇恨言論檢測）中的有效性仍然不明確。先前的研究將提示式LLMs與最先進的編碼器模型（例如，BERT變體（Roy et al., 2023; Dönmez et al., 2024））進行比較，僅顯示出邊際增益，這表明LLMs在仇恨言論檢測或緩解方面可能並不出色。在本研究中，我們通過指令調整的視角重新審視這個問題。通過徹底統一36個涵蓋多種標註方案的英語仇恨言論數據集，我們對基於Qwen3（Qwen Team, 2025）的通用LLM進行微調，專門針對仇恨言論的緩解。我們的結果不僅在領域內基準測試中顯示出最先進的表現，還在跨領域和跨語言泛化方面顯示出顯著的改善——這些都是基於編碼器的專家分類器經常面臨挑戰的領域。
